body:
As someone who has some experience injecting hard drugs I have to say whoa, this is something that is plenty strong on its own, injecting it just makes it almost unbearable. I dont feel anything right away as I would with coke or heroin I can even walk away after I do and about 60 seconds later exactly I feel a quick swelling and a dizziness the crazy thing is they don't stop me. I kept blowing up for about the next 30 minutes.
I almost immediately felt that odd feeling in my gut that X gives me, which is somewhat more unpleasant this way. And sounds take on almost the tone of a ringer like I would get off of coke or nitrous. I was sitting down but then I got up and walked off which wasn't such a good idea I damn near fell over.
